itemdesc-sailorlocust:
A tamed locust in a sailor's hat. Use it on a boat and it takes the helm: it sails from dock to dock along the stops you write for it, around the land, and starts over.

Right click the seat the locust sits in to write its sailing orders. Sneak and right click that seat to take the locust back.

Inspired by the Conductor Locust of Yang's Transport Tycoon and by Boat Autopilot.
itemdesc-routewand: Staff tool. Use it on a boat with a sailor locust to see, for half a minute, the round of its orders, the way it follows now (green) and the points of its coming in (yellow, the berth white). Use it on nothing to take it away.
blockdesc-sailordock: Marks a dock and gives it a name. It looks the way you look when you place it: boats lie in front of it, side to the post (the outline on the water shows where). Right click to name it or to turn the berth.
blockdesc-sailorbuoy: Placed on the water, with a name. A sailor locust told to pass by it does so without stopping: use buoys to lead a boat out of a harbour, through a channel, up a river. Named after a port and given a role in its sheet, it becomes a tall beacon: blue, the waiting area where boats wait out of the way; green, the way out boats leave by.
marker-hint: Sailor locusts find it by this name.
orders-help: One stop on each line, in the order sailed: the name of a dock or a buoy, then ; and the seconds to wait there. Buoys are passed without stopping. After the last line it starts over.
orders-known: Docks and buoys it knows (nearest first):
orders-known-none: No dock and no buoy placed yet.
status-unknown: Knows no dock or buoy called "{0}".
status-chunks: Waiting: the water ahead is not loaded.
status-stuck: Stuck on the way to {0}. Place a buoy to lead it around.
helm-hint: Right click the locust's seat for its sailing orders.
orders-route: The route, in the order sailed (after the last stop it starts over):
orders-empty: No stop yet. Click a dock or a buoy below to add it.
err-nolocust: No sailor locust on this boat or near you.
helm-key: On board or in the water near it, the key for its orders is O (see the controls).
status-berth: Waiting off {0} for a free berth.
status-giveway: Giving way to another boat near {0}.
buoy-role-3: Way in to the port (click: route buoy)
marker-info-entry: Way in to the port {0}: every boat bound for it passes here first.
marker-info-portname: Has the name of a port: it is not a stop. Give it a role (waiting area, way out, way in) or another name.
buoy-role-1: Waiting area of the port (click: way out)
buoy-role-2: Way out of the port (click: way in)
marker-info-wait: Waiting area of the port {0}: boats wait here, out of the way, for a berth or their turn.
marker-info-exit: Way out of the port {0}: boats leaving it pass here before sailing on.
status-waitarea: In the waiting area of {0}, for a berth or its turn.
status-waitturn: At {0}: waiting its turn to leave.
marker-info-small: Small boats only (up to {0} blocks long).
dock-small-off: All boats: keep it for small ones
dock-small-on: Small boats only: open it to all
status-nofit: No berth at {0} takes a boat this size.
err-notvessel: That is not a boat with a helm.
err-hasone: This boat already has a sailor locust.
err-noseat: No free seat at the helm.
err-notowner: This sailor locust takes orders only from the one who placed it.
msg-installed: The sailor locust takes the helm. Right click its seat to write its sailing orders; sneak and right click to take it back.
